question: In March 2022, who was selected for the 31st GD Birla Award for Outstanding Contribution and Scientific Research in the field of Physics?
solution:
The correct answer is** '__Professor Narayan Pradhan__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Professor Narayan Pradhan** has been selected for the 31st GD Birla Award for Scientific Research 2022 for his outstanding contribution in the field of material sciences. 
 
• This was announced by the K.K. Birla Foundation on 14 March 2022.​
 
• 
 
The award is given to outstanding scientific research, mostly during the past 5 years, undertaken by an Indian scientist, who is below the age of 50, living and working in india.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ghanshyam Das Birla** (10 April 1894 – 11 June 1983) was an Indian businessman and member of the Birla Family.
 
• The GD Birla Award for Scientific Research, which was established in 1991 to promote young scientists working in the field of research, should be acknowledged.
